treatment_summary: Continue lisinopril 10 mg daily and add amlodipine 5 mg daily to achieve BP <140/90 mmHg (NG136). Initiate atorvastatin 20 mg nightly for primary CVD prevention (CG181). Start metformin 500 mg BID, titrating to 1 g BID, after confirming eGFR ≥30 ml/min/1.73 m² (PH38). Switch combined estrogen OCP to desogestrel 75 µg daily to remove estrogen‑related BP elevation. Order baseline labs (eGFR, potassium, LFTs, lipid panel, HbA1c, urine ACR) and calculate QRISK. Provide lifestyle advice (DASH diet, <6 g salt, 150 min exercise, weight loss, smoking cessation). Review BP and labs in 4 weeks, then at 3‑month intervals for statin and metformin, with annual comprehensive review.
